meta.title: Open Physics Problems Map
meta.description: Curated, multi-source catalog of open problems in physics with AI tractability estimates, cross-links, and landscape maps.

primary_sources.name: Wikipedia: List of unsolved problems in physics
John Baez Open Questions in Physics FAQ
Clay Mathematics Institute Millennium Prize Problems
Coley: Open problems in mathematical physics (arXiv:1710.02105)

ai_tractability_rubric.high: Formal proof, mechanism from existing data, or computational theory problem where AI reasoning/simulation can plausibly close or nearly close the problem.
ai_tractability_rubric.medium: AI can accelerate theory/model selection substantially, but decisive progress needs new experiments or facilities.
ai_tractability_rubric.low: Empirically gated or underdetermined; AI helps explore theory space but cannot decide alone.
ai_tractability_rubric.none: Requires new discovery-class experiments, Planck-scale access, or is not uniquely decidable by science as currently framed.

problems.name: Theory of everything
problems.summary: Is there a single coherent framework that unifies all fundamental interactions and explains all physical phenomena?
problems.why_hard: Requires reconciling quantum field theory with general relativity and matching all low-energy data.

problems.name: Dimensionless physical constants
problems.summary: Can the dimensionless constants of nature (fine-structure constant, mass ratios, etc.) be derived from first principles, or are some historical/quantum accidents?
problems.why_hard: No accepted principle selects observed values; may require multiverse/anthropic reasoning or a TOE.

problems.name: Anthropic principle necessity
problems.summary: Are important aspects of the universe only understandable via anthropic selection, or is the principle unnecessary/unscientific?
problems.why_hard: Blurs physics and philosophy; hard to falsify cleanly.

problems.name: Quantum gravity
problems.summary: Can quantum mechanics and general relativity be realized as a fully consistent theory? Is spacetime continuous or discrete? Graviton-mediated or emergent?
problems.why_hard: Planck-scale physics is experimentally almost inaccessible; multiple incomplete frameworks compete.

problems.ai_notes: Theoretical consensus may crystallize via holography/quantum info arguments; full QG still needed.
problems.name: Black hole information paradox
problems.summary: Do black holes radiate thermally as Hawking predicted? Does radiation encode interior information? What remains after evaporation?
problems.why_hard: Tensions unitarity, locality, and semiclassical gravity in extreme regimes.

problems.name: Hawking radiation confirmation
problems.summary: Do real black holes emit Hawking radiation as predicted? Observable only for microscopic or analogue systems so far.
problems.why_hard: Astrophysical Hawking temperatures are tiny; relies on analogues or future precision.

problems.ai_notes: Mathematical GR conjecture; partial results exist; AI formal math could help.
problems.name: Cosmic censorship hypothesis
problems.summary: Can naked singularities form from realistic initial conditions, or does nature always hide them behind horizons?
problems.why_hard: Global nonlinear PDE analysis of Einstein equations under generic conditions.

problems.name: Chronology protection conjecture
problems.summary: Does quantum gravity forbid closed timelike curves / macroscopic time travel as Hawking suggested?
problems.why_hard: Requires a complete quantum gravity theory of realistic spacetimes.

problems.ai_notes: Math progress on dualities; realistic cosmology (dS) remains hard.
problems.name: Holographic principle (general)
problems.summary: Does quantum gravity admit a lower-dimensional dual without gravity? Can AdS/CFT be generalized to de Sitter and arbitrary asymptotics?
problems.why_hard: Best understood only in AdS; our universe is approximately de Sitter.

problems.name: Emergence of spacetime
problems.summary: How does classical continuous spacetime emerge from discrete/quantum microphysics (LQG, entanglement in AdS/CFT, etc.)?
problems.why_hard: No complete derivation of 4D classical GR dynamics from a unique microtheory of our universe.

problems.name: Problem of time
problems.summary: How to reconcile time as a universal background parameter in QM with dynamical spacetime in GR?
problems.why_hard: Conceptual clash between two successful theories; multiple incompatible proposals.

problems.name: M-theory fundamental degrees of freedom
problems.summary: What are the fundamental degrees of freedom of M-theory, and does it describe Nature?
problems.why_hard: No complete nonperturbative definition connected to unique low-energy physics.

problems.name: Why 3+1 spacetime dimensions
problems.summary: Why does the universe appear to have one time and three space dimensions?
problems.why_hard: May be environmental; no unique dynamical selection principle established.

problems.ai_notes: Pure formal math; top AI formal-reasoning target among physics problems.
problems.name: Yang–Mills existence and mass gap
problems.summary: Prove existence of a nontrivial quantum Yang–Mills theory on R^4 with a mass gap (Clay Millennium Prize).
problems.why_hard: Nonperturbative constructive QFT in 4D is extremely difficult.

problems.ai_notes: Mathematical physics; AI can assist constructive methods and proofs.
problems.name: Rigorous interacting 4D QFT
problems.summary: Construct mathematically rigorous interacting quantum field theories in 4D spacetime without relying only on perturbation theory.
problems.why_hard: UV divergences, renormalization, and nonperturbative control in 4D.

problems.ai_notes: Closely related to mass gap; lattice evidence strong but proof missing.
problems.name: Color confinement (analytic proof)
problems.summary: Provide an analytic proof that color-charged particles are confined in non-Abelian gauge theory / QCD.
problems.why_hard: Nonperturbative strong-coupling dynamics without complete analytic tools.

problems.ai_notes: Pure analysis; among best LLM/AI math targets.
problems.name: Navier–Stokes existence and smoothness
problems.summary: Do smooth solutions to 3D incompressible Navier–Stokes exist for all time for nice initial data, or do singularities form? (Clay Millennium)
problems.why_hard: Nonlinear PDE blow-up control in 3D is a century-old challenge.

problems.ai_notes: Data-rich; ML + theory of cascades/structure functions highly promising.
problems.name: Statistical theory of turbulence
problems.summary: Is there a closed theoretical model for the statistics and internal structures of turbulent flow?
problems.why_hard: Strong nonlinearity, multiscale energy cascade, lack of closed equations for moments.

problems.name: Nature of dark matter
problems.summary: What is dark matter? WIMP, axion, sterile neutrino, primordial black holes, modified gravity, or something else?
problems.why_hard: Only gravitational evidence so far; vast candidate space; null direct searches.

problems.name: Nature of dark energy
problems.summary: What causes the accelerated expansion of the universe? Cosmological constant, quintessence, modified gravity, or misinterpreted data?
problems.why_hard: Equation of state near -1; many models fit current data.

problems.name: Cosmological constant problem
problems.summary: Why is vacuum energy density ~120 orders of magnitude smaller than naive QFT estimates? What cancels it?
problems.why_hard: Worst fine-tuning problem in physics; no consensus mechanism.

problems.ai_notes: AI can help systematics hunting and model comparison; needs better data to close.
problems.name: Hubble tension
problems.summary: Why do early-universe (CMB+ΛCDM) and late-universe (distance ladder) measurements of H0 disagree at high significance (~5σ)?
problems.why_hard: Could be unknown systematics or new physics; hard to decide with current precision.

problems.name: Matter–antimatter asymmetry
problems.summary: Why is the observable universe dominated by matter rather than equal matter and antimatter?
problems.why_hard: Requires Sakharov conditions; many mechanisms; need decisive experimental input (e.s. EDMs, CPV).

problems.name: Cosmic inflation details
problems.summary: Is inflation correct? What is the inflaton? Is inflation eternal? Are there viable alternatives?
problems.why_hard: Many models fit CMB; need primordial B-modes or other decisive probes.

problems.name: Horizon problem / alternatives
problems.summary: Why is the distant universe so homogeneous? Is inflation the unique solution?
problems.why_hard: Inflation is standard but not unique; alternatives hard to distinguish.

problems.name: Cosmic coincidence problem
problems.summary: Why are dark matter and dark energy densities comparable today despite different evolution?
problems.why_hard: May be anthropic or dynamical coupling; underdetermined.

problems.name: Origin and fate of the universe
problems.summary: How did conditions for existence arise? Big Freeze, Rip, Crunch, or Bounce?
problems.why_hard: Requires quantum gravity + true dark-energy dynamics into the far future.

problems.name: Size, shape, and topology of the universe
problems.summary: Is the universe infinite? What is the 3-manifold topology of comoving space?
problems.why_hard: Beyond the particle horizon is unobservable in principle.

problems.ai_notes: Survey statistics + anomaly hunting; AI helps but data decides.
problems.name: Cosmological principle validity
problems.summary: Is the universe homogeneous and isotropic on large scales? Is FLRW the right metric? Is CMB dipole purely kinematic?
problems.why_hard: Requires all-sky deep surveys free of systematics.

problems.name: Extra dimensions
problems.summary: Does nature have more than 4 spacetime dimensions? What size? Fundamental or emergent?
problems.why_hard: No experimental signal; vast model space.

problems.name: Dark flow
problems.summary: Is there a bulk flow of galaxy clusters from gravitational pull outside the observable universe?
problems.why_hard: Observationally disputed; needs better peculiar-velocity data.

problems.ai_notes: Could be stellar depletion or nuclear/astrophysics systematics—analysis-heavy.
problems.name: Cosmological lithium problem
problems.summary: Why does Big Bang nucleosynthesis overpredict 7Li relative to old stars?
problems.why_hard: Tension between nuclear theory, stellar atmospheres, and observations.

problems.name: Hierarchy problem
problems.summary: Why is gravity so weak compared to other forces / why is the electroweak scale far below the Planck scale?
problems.why_hard: Naturalness arguments failed at LHC so far; may need new philosophy of theory choice.

problems.ai_notes: Theory space mappable by AI; existence of axions is experimental.
problems.name: Strong CP problem
problems.summary: Why is the QCD θ angle so tiny? Is Peccei–Quinn / axion the solution?
problems.why_hard: Fine-tuning without new symmetry; axion searches ongoing.

problems.name: Neutrino masses and nature
problems.summary: Absolute neutrino mass scale? Dirac or Majorana? Normal or inverted hierarchy? CP phase? Sterile neutrinos?
problems.why_hard: Requires β-decay, 0νββ, oscillation, and cosmology experiments.

problems.name: Three generations of matter
problems.summary: Why three generations of quarks and leptons? Can Yukawa couplings be derived from first principles?
problems.why_hard: Flavor structure appears arbitrary; many models, few decisive tests.

problems.ai_notes: Pattern discovery + model search; may be coincidence.
problems.name: Koide formula
problems.summary: Why does a simple relation among charged lepton masses hold to high precision (Q≈2/3)?
problems.why_hard: Could be accident; no accepted dynamical origin.

problems.name: Proton decay
problems.summary: Is the proton stable? If not, what is its lifetime and decay modes (GUT predictions)?
problems.why_hard: Lifetimes >10^34 yr; needs megaton-scale detectors over decades.

problems.name: Grand unification
problems.summary: Do EM, weak, and strong forces unify at high energy? Under what symmetry?
problems.why_hard: Needs proton decay or other smoking-gun signals near GUT scale.

problems.name: Supersymmetry realization
problems.summary: Is spacetime supersymmetry realized near the TeV scale? How is it broken? Is the LSP dark matter?
problems.why_hard: No LHC discovery of superpartners so far; parameter space vast.

problems.name: Magnetic monopoles
problems.summary: Did magnetic monopoles exist in the early universe? Do any remain? Do they explain charge quantization?
problems.why_hard: Extremely rare if any; searches null so far.

problems.ai_notes: Hadronic vacuum polarization theory (lattice/dispersive) is AI-accelerable; experiment continues.
problems.name: Muon anomalous magnetic moment
problems.summary: Why does the experimental muon g−2 differ from some Standard Model predictions?
problems.why_hard: Tension may be theory systematics or new physics—needs both better SM theory and data.

problems.ai_notes: Classic systematics + nuclear theory reconciliation problem.
problems.name: Neutron lifetime puzzle
problems.summary: Why do bottle and beam measurements of the free neutron lifetime disagree?
problems.why_hard: Subtle experimental systematics vs possible new physics.

problems.ai_notes: Nuclear data + flux models; sterile neutrino hypothesis testable.
problems.name: Reactor antineutrino anomaly
problems.summary: Why is measured reactor antineutrino flux ~6% below some predictions?
problems.why_hard: Nuclear data uncertainties vs sterile neutrinos.

problems.ai_notes: Analysis and nuclear physics heavy.
problems.name: Gallium anomaly
problems.summary: Why do gallium solar-neutrino calibration source experiments see a deficit?

problems.ai_notes: Global QCD analyses + lattice; data-driven.
problems.name: Proton spin crisis
problems.summary: How do quarks and gluons fully account for the proton's spin?
problems.why_hard: Nonperturbative QCD structure of nucleons.

problems.ai_notes: Spectroscopy + lattice + amplitude analysis.
problems.name: Exotic hadrons structure
problems.summary: What combinations of quarks exist (pentaquarks, tetraquarks)? Tightly bound multiquarks or molecules?
problems.why_hard: Many states; ambiguous binding mechanisms.

problems.name: Glueballs
problems.summary: Do pure-glue bound states (glueballs) exist in nature, and which observed mesons are they?
problems.why_hard: Mix with ordinary mesons; hard experimental ID.

problems.name: Strange matter stability
problems.summary: Does strange quark matter exist? Is it stable at zero pressure? Strange stars?
problems.why_hard: Nonperturbative QCD equation of state uncertainties.

problems.name: QCD vacuum and nuclear complexity
problems.summary: How does nonperturbative QCD produce complex nuclei and nuclear structure from quarks and gluons?
problems.why_hard: Multi-scale many-body problem from QCD to nuclei.

problems.name: μ problem in SUSY
problems.summary: Why is the supersymmetric μ parameter of the electroweak scale rather than Planck scale?
problems.why_hard: Model-building within SUSY frameworks; depends on SUSY existing.

problems.ai_notes: Solar data + MHD/kinetic models; AI-assisted reconnection theory.
problems.name: Solar coronal heating problem
problems.summary: Why is the Sun's corona much hotter than its surface? Why is magnetic reconnection so fast?
problems.why_hard: Multi-scale plasma physics from photosphere to corona.

problems.ai_notes: Nonlinear dynamo theory + long solar records.
problems.name: Solar cycle and dynamos
problems.summary: How does the Sun generate its reversing large-scale magnetic field? What causes grand minima like Maunder?

problems.ai_notes: GRMHD + ML pattern discovery in timing data.
problems.name: Astrophysical jets and QPOs
problems.summary: Why do some accretion disks launch relativistic jets? What sets QPO frequencies and overtones?

problems.ai_notes: Classic spectral matching + molecular database search—excellent AI target.
problems.name: Diffuse interstellar bands
problems.summary: What molecules or materials cause the numerous unidentified interstellar absorption bands?

problems.name: Supermassive black hole origins
problems.summary: How did early quasars grow SMBHs to ~10^10 M☉ so quickly? Origin of M–σ relation?
problems.why_hard: Needs early-universe growth channels constrained by deep surveys.

problems.ai_notes: N-body Solar System formation simulations.
problems.name: Kuiper cliff
problems.summary: Why does Kuiper belt object density drop sharply beyond ~50 AU?

problems.ai_notes: Likely systematics; trajectory reanalysis.
problems.name: Flyby anomaly
problems.summary: Why do some Earth flybys show tiny unexpected energy changes?

problems.name: Galaxy rotation problem
problems.summary: Are flat rotation curves due to dark matter, modified gravity, or both?
problems.why_hard: Entangled with DM identity; multi-probe tests needed.

problems.ai_notes: Multi-physics simulation + AI surrogates; converging but not closed.
problems.name: Core-collapse supernova mechanism
problems.summary: What exact mechanism turns stellar core collapse into a successful explosion?

problems.ai_notes: Reaction networks + stellar models.
problems.name: Origin of p-nuclei
problems.summary: What astrophysical process produces rare proton-rich isotopes (p-nuclei)?

problems.name: Ultra-high-energy cosmic rays
problems.summary: What sources accelerate particles above the GZK limit region, and how?
problems.why_hard: Rare events; composition and source ID incomplete.

problems.notes: Some related spin discrepancies resolved via gravity field; residual questions remain.
problems.name: Saturn deep rotation rate
problems.summary: What is the true rotation rate of Saturn's deep interior given magnetospheric period puzzles?

problems.name: Magnetar magnetic field origin
problems.summary: What is the origin of magnetars' extreme magnetic fields?

problems.name: Large-scale cosmic anisotropy
problems.summary: Do radio/CMB/quasar polarization anomalies indicate large-scale anisotropy violating the cosmological principle?

problems.name: Ultraluminous X-ray sources
problems.summary: What powers ULXs exceeding Eddington limits—IMBHs, beamed neutron stars, or both?

problems.ai_notes: Model ranking against multiwavelength catalogs; confirmation observational.
problems.name: Fast radio bursts
problems.summary: What causes millisecond radio bursts from distant galaxies? Why do some repeat?

problems.name: Origin of cosmic magnetic fields
problems.summary: How were large-scale magnetic fields generated from galaxies to clusters?
problems.why_hard: Primordial seed vs dynamo amplification hard to disentangle uniquely.

problems.ai_notes: Survey data + chemical evolution models.
problems.name: Galactic age–metallicity relation
problems.summary: Is there a universal age–metallicity relation in thin/thick Galactic disks?

problems.ai_notes: Heavy-ion data analysis + hydro/transport models.
problems.name: Quark–gluon plasma onset and properties
problems.summary: Where is deconfinement onset in T–μ space? Why ideal flow? Flavor equilibration? Perfect statistical hadronization?

problems.name: Nature of the nuclear force from QCD
problems.summary: What is the precise nature of the nuclear force binding nuclei, rooted in QCD?

problems.ai_notes: Nuclear PDF phenomenology + short-range correlations.
problems.name: EMC effect
problems.summary: Why do quark distributions in bound nucleons differ from free nucleons?

problems.name: Neutron star dense matter EOS
problems.summary: What is the equation of state of ultra-dense nuclear matter in neutron stars?
problems.why_hard: Needs multimessenger GW + X-ray + nuclear theory.

problems.name: Heaviest possible chemical element
problems.summary: What is the heaviest element that can exist (island of stability limits)?

problems.name: Color glass condensate / gluon saturation
problems.summary: Do gluons saturate into a color glass condensate? What are decisive experimental signatures?

problems.ai_notes: Huge data; theory model selection + materials AI; mechanism still debated.
problems.name: High-temperature superconductivity mechanism
problems.summary: What mechanism causes high-Tc superconductivity in cuprates and related materials? Is room-temperature ambient SC possible?
problems.why_hard: Strong correlations; many competing orders; materials complexity.

problems.ai_notes: Conceptual + computational stat-mech; major AI theory target.
problems.name: Glass transition
problems.summary: What is the nature of the glass transition and universal properties of amorphous solids?
problems.why_hard: No consensus thermodynamic vs kinetic theory of the transition.

problems.name: Low-T amorphous solid universality
problems.summary: Why is the phonon wavelength to mean-free-path ratio nearly universal across disordered solids?

problems.ai_notes: Focused condensed-matter theory + numerics.
problems.name: Fractional quantum Hall ν=5/2 state
problems.summary: What is the mechanism of the 5/2 FQHE state? Non-Abelian anyons?

problems.ai_notes: Theory + numerics of topological codes.
problems.name: Topological order at finite temperature
problems.summary: Is topological order stable at T>0? Can 3D self-correcting quantum memory exist?

problems.ai_notes: Likely closeable with careful multi-physics modeling.
problems.name: Sonoluminescence mechanism
problems.summary: What causes light flashes from sound-driven imploding bubbles?

problems.ai_notes: Materials multi-scale simulation problem.
problems.name: Metal whiskering
problems.summary: What is the growth mechanism of spontaneous metal whiskers causing electronics failures?

problems.name: Gauge block wringing
problems.summary: What mechanism allows precision gauge blocks to wring together?

problems.ai_notes: RG + finite-size effects reconciliation.
problems.name: Helium-4 superfluid critical exponent α
problems.summary: Explain discrepancy between experimental and theoretical heat-capacity critical exponent α near the lambda point.

problems.name: Cryogenic electron emission anomaly
problems.summary: Why does dark electron emission in photomultipliers increase as temperature decreases?

problems.name: Quantum-dot energy-size nonparabolicity
problems.summary: What causes nonparabolicity of the lowest optical absorption vs size in semiconductor nanocrystals?

problems.name: Nematic–smectic-A transition universality
problems.summary: Can the nematic to smectic-A transition be characterized as a universal phase transition?

problems.ai_notes: Theoretical consistency clarification; no causality violation expected in practice.
problems.name: Scharnhorst effect
problems.summary: Can light travel slightly faster than c between closely spaced conducting plates via Casimir vacuum modification?

problems.ai_notes: Soft-matter simulation + theory; much progress already.
problems.name: Granular convection / Brazil-nut effect
problems.summary: Why do shaken granular materials convect and size-segregate?

problems.ai_notes: AI helps codes/control; hardware still rules.
problems.name: Fault-tolerant quantum computing scalability
problems.summary: Can we go beyond NISQ to fault-tolerant scalable quantum computers with practical error correction?
problems.why_hard: Requires qubit quality, scale, and systems engineering.

problems.name: Topological qubits / Majorana modes
problems.summary: Can topological quantum computers be built? Can Majorana zero modes be demonstrated conclusively?
problems.why_hard: Fabrication + unambiguous experimental signatures.

problems.name: Non-cryogenic quantum computing
problems.summary: Can useful quantum computing operate at non-cryogenic / room temperature?

problems.ai_notes: Complexity theory; formal methods friendly.
problems.name: BQP vs BPP / NP relations
problems.summary: What is the precise relation of BQP to classical complexity classes? Can physical computation exceed BQP?

problems.ai_notes: Formal security reductions; high AI leverage.
problems.name: Post-quantum cryptography proofs
problems.summary: Can we prove that specific cryptographic protocols remain secure against quantum adversaries?

problems.ai_notes: Quantum information theory math.
problems.name: Quantum channel capacity
problems.summary: What is the quantum capacity of general quantum channels (often unknown in closed form)?

problems.ai_notes: Theory+control AI helps; multi-billion experiments decide.
problems.name: Fusion plasma confinement / H-mode
problems.summary: Can plasmas be confined long enough and hot enough for practical fusion power? What is the physical origin of H-mode?
problems.why_hard: Turbulence, stability, materials, and systems integration.

problems.name: Fermi acceleration injection problem
problems.summary: What pre-accelerates particles enough for Fermi acceleration to take over in astrophysical shocks?

problems.ai_notes: Data-rich space plasma statistics.
problems.name: Alfvénic turbulence
problems.summary: How does MHD/Alfvénic turbulence work in solar wind, flares, CMEs, and substorms?

problems.name: Ball lightning
problems.summary: What is the physical nature of ball lightning?
problems.why_hard: Rare, poorly documented events; many candidate mechanisms.

problems.notes: Ginzburg listed life from physics as a 'great problem'.
problems.name: Abiogenesis
problems.summary: Can life arise from purely physical/chemical processes? What pathway produced life on Earth?
problems.why_hard: Historical path underdetermined; vast chemical space.

problems.ai_notes: Kinetic/symmetry-breaking models.
problems.name: Homochirality origin
problems.summary: Why do biomolecules prefer specific enantiomers?

problems.ai_notes: Radical-pair vs other models; biophysics theory + experiments.
problems.name: Magnetoreception mechanism
problems.summary: How do animals (e.g. migratory birds) sense Earth's magnetic field?

problems.name: Gene expression noise and developmental robustness
problems.summary: How do genetic networks remain robust under external pressure and internal stochasticity, especially in development?

problems.name: Quantitative immune system networks
problems.summary: What are quantitative building blocks and network properties of immune responses?

problems.ai_notes: Structure prediction largely advanced by AlphaFold-class models; kinetic/thermodynamic physics still open.
problems.notes: Wikipedia still lists structure prediction; ML largely solved prediction for many proteins.
problems.name: Protein folding physics (beyond structure prediction)
problems.summary: How do proteins fold so fast? Are native states global free-energy minima? How do cells avoid precipitation at high density?

problems.ai_notes: Rigorous model audit of claims is AI-friendly.
problems.name: Quantum biology functional coherence
problems.summary: Can quantum coherence persist long enough to be functionally important in warm, wet biology?

problems.name: Biology from fundamental physical laws
problems.summary: Can biology be expressed via fundamental laws, action principles, and symmetries (robustness, modularity, evolvability)?
problems.why_hard: Enormous hierarchical complexity; unclear if unique reduction exists.

problems.name: Interpretation of quantum mechanics / measurement problem
problems.summary: How does the quantum formalism give rise to definite outcomes? What is a measurement? Which of locality/causality/realism must be sacrificed?
problems.why_hard: Multiple empirically equivalent interpretations; may not have unique scientific answer.

problems.name: Arrow of time
problems.summary: Why does time have a direction? Why was the early universe low entropy? How do thermodynamic, cosmological, and quantum arrows relate?
problems.why_hard: Tied to cosmological initial conditions; deep and possibly anthropic.

problems.name: Nature of quantum non-locality
problems.summary: Are non-local phenomena limited to Bell entanglement, or can information/conserved quantities move non-locally? Implications for spacetime structure?
problems.why_hard: Constrained by no-signaling but conceptually unsettled.

problems.name: Quantum mind
problems.summary: Do quantum phenomena play an essential role in brain function and consciousness?
problems.why_hard: Highly speculative; lacks decisive experimental support.

problems.ai_notes: Deep math; formal AI systems may help bridges.
problems.name: Geometric Langlands and physics
problems.summary: Can the Langlands program explain physical symmetries and vice versa?

recently_solved.notes: Local hidden variables ruled out at high confidence
